title: Glitch Anatomy | ECHO//100 Episode 11
description: Kavi’s corrupted hand whispers the secrets of the missing citizens as he infiltrates the Archive Core. Episode 11 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: Kavi’s hand shifts from flesh into a discordant choir of shivering, stolen voices.
scenes.caption: Kavi's corrupted hand
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Kavi in his red hoodie, his right hand glowing with purple digital corruption, sparks flying.

scenes.text: Those voices belong to missing neighbors, now trapped within the static beneath Kavi’s skin.
scenes.caption: Whispering neighbors
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his glowing hand while Byte floats nervously nearby with a flickering cyan face.

scenes.text: Kavi requires the Archive Core to map this corruption before the glitch consumes everything.
scenes.caption: Entering the Core
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and Byte standing before a massive, glowing holographic database tower inside a dark metallic room.

scenes.text: Byte scans the purple veins, revealing compressed city data rather than simple organic decay.
scenes.caption: The data revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Byte projecting a complex 3D map of the city streets from Kavi's hand onto the walls.

scenes.text: Every pixel represents a captured moment from the missing hour, frozen in digital amber.
scenes.caption: The missing hour
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at the holographic projection, his face illuminated by the swirling purple data stream.

scenes.text: Mira emerges, admitting she archived the missing hour to keep the city looping indefinitely.
scenes.caption: Mira's betrayal
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal holographic coat standing coldly behind Kavi, her hand hovering over a console.

scenes.text: Mira refuses to purge the data, tethering Kavi’s soul to this failing, artificial reality.
scenes.caption: Tethered to code
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi restrained by glowing blue light chains emanating from Mira's console, his hand glowing intensely.

scenes.text: Kavi’s shadow peels away from the boots, marching toward the Red Door without permission.
scenes.caption: The runaway shadow
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi watching in horror as his dark shadow detaches and walks toward a glowing Red Door.
